title: Hear the View, Reason, and Concern
status: New proposed Lesson 03 production script, 2026-10-29. No new animation or narration in this handoff.
learningOutcome: Identify what a speaker proposes, the reason offered and an expressed concern; preserve uncertainty and separate what was said from interpretation.

scenario.task: Plan a 30-minute paper-folding workshop for beginners. Give participants an opportunity to try and ask questions.
scenario.baselineQuote: I would keep the demonstration brief, so people have time to try. I am worried that someone who misses a step could get left behind.
scenario.scope: No institution, official test, observed learner performance or measured outcome is represented. S07 uses a fresh club-guide scenario.

blocks.title: Separate the View from Its Reason
Hear a Concern Without Expanding It

L03.S01.c001.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c001.text: A reply can sound relevant because it mentions the same topic, yet miss the point someone has made. Before preparing your next sentence, notice what their contribution actually contains.
L03.S01.c001.visualEn: Open on two idea cards using the same topic, with different connections. The first relationship remains unresolved rather than marked wrong. Transition into the fictional task; no permanent character room.
L03.S01.c001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c001.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c002.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c002.text: Imagine a group planning a thirty-minute paper-folding workshop for beginners. There is one facilitator and shared materials. The aim is to give participants an opportunity to try and ask questions. No workshop has taken place.
L03.S01.c002.visualEn: Establish a clearly labelled fictional planning frame: a 30-minute rail, one facilitator symbol and shared paper. Keep proposal status visible; no teaching session, attendance results or adoption.
L03.S01.c002.anchorHint: an opportunity to try and ask questions
L03.S01.c002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c002.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.d001.speaker: noah
L03.S01.d001.text: I would keep the demonstration brief, so people have time to try. I am worried that someone who misses a step could get left behind.
L03.S01.d001.visualEn: Brief character example with Noah. Present the exact English line in timed speech segments. Retain the fictional planning frame. No imagined beginner is shown actually falling behind.
L03.S01.d001.anchorHint: someone who misses a step could get left behind
L03.S01.d001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.d001.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L03.S01.c003.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c003.text: Noah offers a proposal, explains its purpose, and raises a concern. These are useful things to notice, rather than three boxes that every speaker must fill.
L03.S01.c003.visualEn: Return to full-screen explanation. Reuse fragments from Noah’s line as three neutral cards. Do not turn this into a rubric, detected speaker score or mandatory three-part sentence.
L03.S01.c003.anchorHint: a proposal, explains its purpose, and raises a concern
L03.S01.c003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c003.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c004.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c004.text: His proposal is to keep the demonstration brief. That does not mean removing it. The word brief limits the time spent demonstrating; it does not tell us an exact duration.
L03.S01.c004.visualEn: Extract keep the demonstration brief into a view card. Contrast brief with a separate unasserted no-demonstration token, without attributing that token to Noah.
L03.S01.c004.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c004.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c005.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c005.text: His reason is to leave time for people to try. This connects to the workshop aim. He has explained why the proposal may matter, without showing that it will work.
L03.S01.c005.visualEn: Connect the proposal card to time to try and then the stated task aim. Use conditional links; no completed timetable, adopted plan or outcome chart.
L03.S01.c005.anchorHint: leave time for people to try
L03.S01.c005.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c005.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c006.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c006.text: Look at those two parts separately. Which tells the group what Noah suggests, and which explains why he suggests it? Think about the link before moving on.
L03.S01.c006.visualEn: Keep the two exact quote fragments visible without a moving answer cursor. Invite private thought; no clicks, recording, answer capture or inferred success.
L03.S01.c006.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c006.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c007.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c007.text: Keeping the demonstration brief is the proposed action. Leaving time to try is its reason. Hearing both helps you respond to the proposal in relation to the task.
L03.S01.c007.visualEn: Label the same two fragments explicitly as a shared teaching explanation after the hold. Do not replace a learner response or claim the learner identified them.
L03.S01.c007.anchorHint: the proposal in relation to the task
L03.S01.c007.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c007.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c008.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c008.text: The concern is different: someone who misses a step could get left behind. Noah names a possibility. He has not said that every beginner will struggle or that anyone already has.
L03.S01.c008.visualEn: Add the exact concern fragment as a separate card. Preserve someone and could; keep universal and observed-outcome claims outside the stated-content boundary.
L03.S01.c008.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c008.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c009.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c009.text: This concern does not cancel his proposal. It leaves a question about how to support someone who misses a step. For now, keep that question open instead of inventing his solution.
L03.S01.c009.visualEn: Place an unresolved support question beside the proposal. No answer card is prefilled and no facilitator action is enacted.
L03.S01.c009.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c009.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c010.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c010.text: You also do not know how Noah feels about the whole plan. His words identify a concern; they do not establish a personality, a hidden motive or a fixed position against demonstrations.
L03.S01.c010.visualEn: Use a boundary between stated content and interpretations. Avoid facial expressions suggesting anxiety, hostility or certainty not supplied by the line.
L03.S01.c010.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c010.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.d002.speaker: learner
L03.S01.d002.visualEn: Show an authored learner summary in a separate example card. Retain the full source line nearby; do not imply this is the viewer’s response.
L03.S01.d002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.d002.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L03.S01.c011.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c011.text: That summary keeps the proposal, but leaves out its reason and the concern. It may be enough for a narrow confirmation; it is incomplete if we need to check the whole contribution.
L03.S01.c011.visualEn: Highlight the retained view while dimming, not deleting, the source reason and concern. Explain contextual adequacy rather than marking short wording universally bad.
L03.S01.c011.anchorHint: if we need to check the whole contribution
L03.S01.c011.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c011.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.d003.speaker: learner
L03.S01.d003.text: You want a brief demonstration so people have time to try, and you are concerned that someone who misses a step might fall behind.
L03.S01.d003.visualEn: Show a second authored summary, linked back to the three relevant source fragments. Preserve might. No peer confirmation or learner score is invented.
L03.S01.d003.anchorHint: someone who misses a step might fall behind
L03.S01.d003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.d003.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L03.S01.c012.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c012.text: This version keeps more of the meaning without copying every word. It is a possible check, not a script you must repeat whenever another person speaks.
L03.S01.c012.visualEn: Return to explanation. Map meaning between source and summary, not word-for-word matching or a mandatory formula.
L03.S01.c012.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c012.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c013.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c013.text: Privately choose one detail you would listen for before answering Noah. It could be his purpose or the limit of his concern. Nothing is recorded, and there is no required wording.
L03.S01.c013.visualEn: Hide the full summaries. Keep task context and a blank reflection area; do not select a focus on the viewer’s behalf.
L03.S01.c013.anchorHint: choose one detail you would listen for
L03.S01.c013.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c013.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.c014.speaker: coach
L03.S01.c014.text: Useful listening preserves what is there and leaves room for what remains unclear. Next, we will look more closely at checking your understanding without changing the speaker’s point.
L03.S01.c014.visualEn: Settle the view, reason and concern cards with their source wording. End with the next-section title, existing replay available, and no score, purchase or automatic navigation.
L03.S01.c014.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L03.S01.c014.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L03.S01.h101.purpose: Privately distinguish the proposed action from its reason.
L03.S01.h101.visualEn: Hold the two source fragments. No new model appears during the hold; no automatic answer, selected card or success state.

L03.S01.h102.purpose: Privately choose one detail to listen for before answering.
L03.S01.h102.visualEn: Keep the reflection area blank and the fictional task visible. No inferred response, model answer or completion animation.

boundary: Use formal explanation and short examples. No perpetual three-person scene; no school, exam, policy or assessed-learner claim.
